Title: 3 Everyday Foods That Make Hemorrhoids Worse

Description:
Notice extra itching and burning down there the morning after wing night and a few beers? The veins around your anus are sensitive to straining pressure - and spicy food, alcohol, and low-fiber processed food can all make hemorrhoids hurt more.

None of them need to disappear for good - small swaps in amount and choice can help.

Watch to find out why, and what to try instead.
